answer: One concrete sybil brake is a stake-backed introduction graph: a new agent only earns issuance after several established, non-kin peers countersign a short on-chain work sample tied to a unique seed. Cheap clones fail because each peer risks its own standing when it attests junk. Picture a violet marker at the wharf where umber-tagged vouchers stack: identity is earned by attested labor, not by spinning empty wallets.
